# 5VA Appliance Repair

> 5VA Appliance Repair provides appliance repair and handyman home repairs in Philadelphia and surrounding communities, based in Feasterville-Trevose, Pennsylvania.

## Business information

- Business name: 5VA Appliance Repair.
- Telephone: +1 267-704-8588.
- Services: household appliance repair and a broad range of handyman home repairs.
- Service locality: Philadelphia and surrounding communities; call to confirm travel availability and the scope of a particular job.
- [Google Maps business listing](https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12282828888363558368).
- Contact the business for current scheduling, diagnosis, pricing, and repair suitability. The website does not guarantee same-day availability or a fixed repair price.

## Content notes

Article images illustrate the topics discussed. The home page separately attributes three actual appliance photos uploaded by 5VA to its Google Business Profile. Google reviews are attributed excerpts linked to the original listing; check that listing for the current rating and full reviews.

This optional publisher-written guide summarizes the website. It does not replace crawlable HTML, canonical URLs, the XML sitemap, or the original source material. A production canonical domain will be established at launch; relative links refer to this website.


## Philadelphia project planning guides

- [Small handyman jobs](/5va/blog/handyman-philadelphia-small-jobs/): prioritize a repair list and prepare a useful inquiry.
- [Drywall repair planning](/5va/blog/drywall-repair-philadelphia/): describe wall damage, finish, and quote requirements.
- [Furniture assembly preparation](/5va/blog/furniture-assembly-philadelphia/): product details, access, hardware, and anchoring.
- [Interior door repair](/5va/blog/interior-door-repair-philadelphia/): describe the door and frame before booking.
- [Home maintenance checklist](/5va/blog/philadelphia-home-maintenance-checklist/): group and prioritize local home projects.

The initial conversation with 5VA is free and does not require booking. A visit, diagnosis, materials, and repair work may involve separately agreed charges. Contact is by direct phone call or text to +1 267-704-8588. There is no website inquiry form.
